description: OSOM is a team of passionate students participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We are interested in space science, technology, AI, and creative problem-solving. Our goal is to collaborate, innovate, and develop solutions to real-world challenges using NASA's open data. We welcome enthusiastic members with skills in programming, research, design, and data analysis!🫵🏻🔥
summary: SPACE DETECTIVES is an interactive educational web platform that explores abandoned and forgotten human-made equipment on the Moon and Mars. Through mission stories, interactive exploration, case files, maps, images, and quizzes, users can discover the history and significance of these objects. The project transforms space exploration history into an engaging detective experience, helping people understand humanity's journey beyond Earth and the scientific value of equipment left behind on other worlds.
details:
SPACE DETECTIVES is an interactive web application developed to address the challenge of storytelling about abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars.

The platform allows users to explore different missions, discover historical space equipment, and learn about their purpose and significance. It includes interactive Moon and Mars exploration sections, mission case files, storytelling features, maps, image galleries, and quizzes to make learning engaging.

The application is developed using React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Vite. The interface is designed to provide an accessible and engaging experience for students and space enthusiasts.

The creative approach combines educational storytelling with an interactive detective-style experience, encouraging users to investigate forgotten space equipment and understand its contribution to space exploration.

AI Assistance Disclosure: ChatGPT was used to assist with coding, debugging, and troubleshooting during the development of SPACE DETECTIVES. The project implementation, integration, testing, and final decisions were carried out by the team.
